items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: I played with him a good while, too.

ctx.x: He said, uh, I can't figure out who that is.

Joe Howard. Joe Howard? Joe Howard, yeah. You remember Joe Howard, yeah. Oh, yeah. Uh, then he stopped, he stopped playing, and went to play bass, tuba, yeah. Mm-hmm. I played with him a good while, too. Uh, and, uh, he said, yeah, he got too old for his trumpet, so he got on, uh, bass, tuba, you know. And he used to teach, too. He was a good musician. Yes, indeed. And, uh, this son, this son Johnson, you know him?

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: The kid Howard, I played with them wrists a little while... Yeah, I went with Joe Howard's band, but I didn't stay with him long, you know.

ctx.x: Clayton, yeah. King Clayton, yeah. King Clayton, yeah. King Clayton for a while. Mm-hm. And then I played with Lewis Dorman band. Mm-hm. And Auguste Dush . I played with Sam Morgan for a good while. Mm-hm. I played a little while with Joe Howell. And that kid Howell I played with him- I mean Joe Howell I played with him for a little while because he had Frankie Duce in there with him. That's right. The boys wouldn't stick with him on account of Frankie Ducey, we all quit. He had a good band too. The kid Howard, I…
Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Ask him who was in the band when Muck Carey was in the band, I'd be. Right. Yeah, when he finishes there. Then I, uh. He said who was in the band when Muck Carey was there?

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: Like Lewis DeMille, Joe Howard, and uh, uh, uh, Charles Williams, and uh, Perron. All them fellas used to see how I could read it. They'd just help me out.

ctx.x: Oliver? Oliver? He used to play with them. He used to play with me sometime on the job. but I was a saxophone player. All of them? Yeah. All of them? Yeah, he used to play with, Hickory used to play with him, you see. He used to play with me some time on the job. You know Joe was in there, huh? The drummer, and Henry was in there. Son Johnson, you know that? You know Son Johnson, a saxophone player? Oh, yeah. Where's every artist you know him? He teaches now. He teaches somebody down in the conservatory a long…
That's right. He knows Son Fuclos. Did you know Son Fuclos?
